stops.note: meant 'sweet', naming the starchy bulb of a blue-flowered lily prized as a food staple
spread into the Pacific Northwest trade language among many indigenous groups
stops.meaning: the edible bulb of the camas lily

stops.note: recorded by the Lewis and Clark expedition after being fed camas bulbs by the Nez Perce
stops.meaning: a blue-flowered lily with an edible starchy bulb

current_meaning: a blue-flowered lily of western North America with an edible bulb, historically a staple food
